name: Return to the Blasted Lands
objectiveText: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde .

heyhey

When you're doing the 5-part chainquest from Azshara [quest=3621]  
you will in the 2nd Quest [quest=3625] need to choose between 3 weapons, a dagger, staff or a sword.

if u either choose wrong or maybe like i did, sold the item to vendor without noticing that it should be used for the 4th Quest


FEAR NOT ! :D

go to Swamp of Sorrows, talk to [npc=7572] again, and he will give you the option to get a [item=11582] instead.

This way you will still be able to complete the quest, without having to wait for a mate or someone in trade, to have that specific quest.

good luck.
